objects.name: Analytic 2170
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies vendor-specific firmware-update protocol traffic to ICS device IP addresses from a source not in the approved engineering-workstation or firmware-management baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: netflow:ipfix
